ja317:1.1: Matamatam eva rodatha, na hi taṃ rodathā yo marissati, sabbe va sarīradhārino anupubbena jahanti jīvitaṃ.
ja317:2.1: Devamanussā catuppadā pakkhigaṇā uragā ca bhogino asmiṃ sarīre anissarā ramamānā va jahanti jīvitaṃ.
ja317:3.1: Evañ calitaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ manujesu apekkhiya kanditaruditaṃ niratthakaṃ, kiṃ vo sokagaṇābhikīrare.
ja317:4.1: Dhuttā soṇḍā akatā bālā sūrā vīrā ayogino dhīraṃ maññanti bālo ti ye dhammassa akovidā ti.
